explained.4: LUT table rows 4, 5, 6 of the Qt capture: the emtk capture lists the routing channels of its own detectors (0, 1, 2, 3, 8, 9), the same rule as Qt (union of the detectors' channels); the capture state differs only in which setup is loaded.
